summary:
### BIO-NAUTS – Smart Health Monitoring for Astronauts

BIO-NAUTS is a smart wearable health monitoring system designed to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. It uses a Smart Sensor T-Shirt and a Smart Health Watch to collect important body information such as heart rate, blood oxygen level (SpO₂), body temperature, breathing, and physical activity.

The system uses different sensors, including optical, heart rate, temperature, and motion sensors. These sensors continuously collect health data and send it wirelessly to a central system. A processor analyses the collected data, while AI software checks the astronaut's health condition and identifies possible problems. If any unusual changes are detected, the system provides alerts and warnings.

The real-time health dashboard displays health measurements, health trends, and sensor status. This system helps detect health problems early, supports continuous health monitoring, and improves astronaut safety during space missions.

Main Goal: To provide smarter, faster, and more reliable health monitoring for astronauts in space.
details:
Bionauts – Smart Astronaut Health Monitoring System

Bionauts is a smart health monitoring system designed to monitor the health and physical condition of astronauts during space missions.

Our project focuses on monitoring important health parameters using different sensors such as ECG sensors, heart rate sensors, optical sensors, temperature sensors, respiration sensors, motion sensors, EMG sensors, and GSR sensors.

The system aims to collect and display health-related information to help identify unusual changes in an astronaut's physical condition. It can support early detection of potential health concerns and improve astronaut safety during space missions.

The main benefits of this project are continuous health monitoring, early identification of abnormal changes, and improved awareness of astronaut health.

We developed our project prototype using HTML to create a web-based interface that presents the project concept and its features.

Our main goal is to support astronaut health and contribute to safer future space exploration.
